g.text: DEMON-CLASS LIGHT CRUISER • INTERNAL PLAN • PROCGEN REFERENCE v2.2 — WALL CLASSES + ANDROID RACKS
2 FIGHT — push the spine, clear flanking rooms
4 EXTRACT — fall back to breach before blowout
A — Partition: breachable (HP 300, chips under fire)
C — Outer hull: explosion = depressurization risk
Android rack — vacuum-rated breach response (hunt, then seal); destroy racks in advance to unlock venting tactics
PROCGEN NOTE — rooms = nodes, doors = edges, walls = typed edges (A/B/C), spine = critical path. Gated sections are always Class-B bounded: breaching changes how you move, never what you must do.
